items.t: Engine oil sludge (oil gel)
items.job: Remove oil pan and valve covers, clean out sludge, fresh oil

items.t: Stripped cylinder head bolt threads
items.job: Remove head, install thread inserts, new head gasket and bolts

items.t: Excessive oil consumption
items.job: Replace pistons and rings
items.note: Many owners simply top up oil instead; a used engine can be cheaper than an overhaul.

items.t: Sticky, melting or cracked dashboard
items.job: Replace upper dashboard panel
items.note: Owners report about $2,000 at a dealer. A dash cover is a cheap stopgap.

items.t: Convertible top tears, shrinks or lets in water
items.job: Replace convertible top fabric and rear window
items.note: Owners report about $2,200-$2,500 for a top and headliner.

items.t: Convertible top pops or its boot comes apart
items.job: Repair convertible boot with kit or adjust top linkage

items.t: Rear speaker hums or rattles on convertibles
items.job: Repair or replace rear woofer speaker

items.t: Wind noise from the convertible top
items.job: Adjust convertible top and replace weatherstrips

items.t: Crankshaft pulley outer ring can slip (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft pulley

items.t: Rear axle may be weak from improper heat treatment (recall)
items.job: Replace rear axle hub assemblies

items.t: Side curtain airbag strap may be misrouted (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reroute curtain airbag tether straps

items.t: Add-on seat heaters can short and burn the seat (recall)
items.job: Disconnect accessory seat heater and inspect wiring

items.t: Tire load label may be missing (recall)
items.job: Install load capacity label

items.t: Check engine light from a failed oxygen or air-fuel sensor
items.job: Replace front oxygen/air-fuel sensor

items.t: Check engine light for an EVAP vapor leak
items.job: Smoke test EVAP system and replace gas cap or leaking part

items.t: Rotten egg (sulfur) smell from the exhaust
items.job: Diagnose sulfur odor; update engine software or replace catalytic converter if needed
items.note: Often fixed by a software update or fuel change; a new converter is the high end.

items.t: Harsh or jerky automatic shifts
items.job: Reprogram engine/transmission computer and check fluid

items.t: Check engine light for random misfire (P0300)
items.job: Diagnose misfire and replace spark plugs or ignition parts

items.t: Airbag (SRS) warning light stays on
items.job: Diagnose SRS codes and repair seat airbag connector

items.t: Moonroof rubbing or shuddering noise
items.job: Clean, lubricate and adjust moonroof tracks

items.t: Rear suspension noise
items.job: Inspect and repair rear suspension per bulletin

items.t: Tire pressure warning light after tire work
items.job: Reset tire pressure system or replace a sensor

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket

items.t: Water pump leaks coolant
items.job: Replace water pump

items.t: Knocking from worn front strut mounts and sway bar links
items.job: Replace front strut mounts and stabilizer bar links

items.t: Timing belt wears out or snaps
items.job: Replace timing belt (add water pump and tensioner)
items.note: RepairPal estimates about $650-$850 for the belt alone; pump and tensioner add more.

items.t: Water leaks from the sunroof or in heavy rain
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and reseal leaks

items.t: Paint fading and peeling on the roof and hood
items.job: Repaint roof and hood
items.note: Paint and materials vary a lot by shop and color.

items.t: Engine surges or accelerates unevenly
items.job: Clean throttle body and diagnose sensors

items.t: Car pulls or does not track straight
items.job: Four-wheel alignment
